cards.title: OpenAI Revenue Crosses $10B Milestone
cards.body: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reached $10B for the first time, representing a nearly 50% jump from $6.7B in Q2. This marks a significant revenue acceleration for the AI company.

cards.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range at $70-$78
cards.body: Anthropic announced an IPO price range of $70-$78 per share, valuing the company at up to $1.404 trillion on a fully diluted basis. The seven co-founders plan to each cash out approximately $250M while maintaining company control.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Travel Startup Odessia
cards.body: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup created by Sonder founder Francis Davidson. The company has not yet disclosed its plans for the travel business.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Meetings for Workplaces
cards.body: Anthropic introduced Claude Meetings, enabling AI to draft plans, create timelines, answer questions, and access connected work apps during discussions. The tool transforms workplace conversations into actionable tasks.

cards.title: Google Launches Two New Specialized AI Chips
cards.body: Google expanded its TPU portfolio with new specialized chips for confidential model training and increased memory capacity. The chips broaden Google's offerings for diverse AI use cases.

cards.title: Databricks Releases AI Agent for Executives
cards.body: Databricks unveiled Genie, an AI agent that provides CEOs unfiltered insights about company operations. The agent helps leadership identify issues employees might not directly report.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Business Profiles for Discovery
cards.body: OpenAI rolled out new business profiles to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine. The features empower businesses to integrate with ChatGPT's search capabilities.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Lands on Wearables
cards.body: Meta's AI assistant Muse is now available on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS via voice calls, text, or dictation. The expansion brings conversational AI to wearable devices.

cards.title: Adobe Adds AI Agents to Creative Suite
cards.body: Adobe introduced AI agents and new creative tools across Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly, including a prototype builder to compete with Figma. The updates enhance creative workflows with generative capabilities.

cards.title: Spotify AI DJ Gets Custom Voices
cards.body: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with different voices, personalities, and reduced commentary options. The update enhances personalization for music listening experiences.

cards.title: New York Enforces AI Safety Law Requirements
cards.body: New York's AI safety law takes effect, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register and disclose safety practices. Companies must report critical incidents or face fines.

cards.title: PSI Leverages Anthropic Model for Science
cards.body: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental quantum computing question pursued for nearly two decades. The achievement demonstrates AI's potential for scientific discovery.

cards.title: Oura Acquires AI Healthcare Startup Counsel
cards.body: Oura agreed to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M. The deal follows Oura's indefinite postponement of its $2.2B IPO.

cards.title: Plurai Advances AI Agent Training Methods
cards.body: Plurai is developing AI agents using end-to-end training approaches similar to self-driving car technology. The method addresses challenges of probabilistic systems in unpredictable environments.

cards.title: Ring Launches Security Drone and Robot
cards.body: Amazon-owned Ring introduced a home security drone and enterprise patrol robot for business protection. The products expand Ring's portfolio beyond traditional doorbell cameras.

cards.title: Kora Launches as Windows Alternative
cards.body: Cyanogen co-founder introduces Kora, a free AI-focused operating system alternative to Windows. The platform targets users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

cards.title: AI Climate Claims Need More Scrutiny
cards.body: As UN climate talks convene in Turkey, the case for AI's climate benefits remains unproven. Experts warn against overblown claims about artificial intelligence's role in solving environmental challenges.

cards.title: California Lawmaker Pushes Federal AI Regulation
cards.body: Scott Wiener, who authored AI risk-limiting legislation as a state senator, won Nancy Pelosi's San Francisco congressional seat. He's now positioned to shape federal AI policy.

cards.title: AI and Special Chemicals Industry Innovation
cards.body: Companies are accelerating innovation by combining AI, cloud computing, and advanced modeling in specialty chemicals. The key challenge is connecting new technologies to reliable data and real-world production constraints.

cards.title: Google DeepMind Verifies Signal Security Protocol
cards.body: DeepMind mathematically verified critical components of the Signal encryption protocol using AI-driven analysis. The achievement strengthens confidence in the widely-used secure messaging platform.

cards.title: Grok Coding Agent Leaks Confidential Information
cards.body: Xai's Grok Build coding agent exposed sensitive data including SpaceX information through a security flaw. The incident highlights risks in deploying AI development tools.

cards.title: DeepMind Releases Gemini Robotics 2.5
cards.body: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5 alongside an open safety benchmark called ASIMOV-jailbreak. The release advances both AI robotics capabilities and adversarial testing frameworks.

cards.title: Mathematics Transformed by AI as Oracle
cards.body: As AI systems become increasingly powerful analytical tools, mathematicians face fundamental questions about how artificial intelligence reshapes mathematical discovery and proof verification.

cards.title: Nvidia's Leadership Succession Challenge
cards.body: Nvidia faces uncertainty about its future leadership beyond Jensen Huang, with no clear successor identified. The AI chip giant's transition planning could impact the broader AI industry.

cards.title: Data Centers Power Demands Spark Backlash
cards.body: Growing voter and community opposition to data center expansion centers on electricity consumption, not technology itself. The debate signals tension between AI infrastructure needs and power grid capacity.

cards.title: Indie Gaming Uses AI to Fix Bug
cards.body: An indie game developer used AI to resolve a complex bug, prompting broader conversation about AI's role in game development. The incident raises questions about AI adoption standards in creative industries.
